description: DRAFT. A device, or one person's account on a device, that belongs to a user's trusted device set. Carried by the device itself and gossiped between devices; there is no shared repository. Capabilities are not part of this record: they are announced live in a capability manifest. The namespace org.ligatureprotocol is a placeholder; the domain is not yet registered.

main.description: Signed record describing one trusted device or user-device binding and its keys.

deviceId.description: Stable opaque identifier for the device, derived from its signing key.

displayName.description: Human-readable name chosen by the user.

kind.description: Whether this record describes the device itself (principal) or one person's account on it (binding). A personal device is a single binding. See spec chapter 10.

owner.description: For a principal: the DID of the identity or group that owns the device. For a binding: the DID of the account holder (also the record's repository owner).

principal.description: For a binding on a shared device: the deviceId of the device principal it runs on.

signingKey.description: Device long-term signing public key as a did:key string.

crossSignature.description: Signature over signingKey by the user's self-signing key (see spec chapter 02).

mlsKeyPackage.description: Opaque MLS KeyPackage for adding this device to the device set group.

revoked.description: True once the device has been revoked. Revoked records are retained for audit.
